text:
Maya (partnerships): Quick sync  partner asked for an observability-focused checklist for the Snowflake+Databricks connector tile and wants us to call out telemetry hooks. need runbook + marketplace copy by EOD Thu.
Rico (eng): ok. what specifically do they want under 'observability'? traces, metrics, alerts?
Nina (pm): partner asks for three bullets: realtime ingest latency, vector upsert health, and end-to-end error rates. they'd like sample Grafana panels/screenshots.
Sam (field-eng): tech side: we'll include logs schema, Prometheus metrics (ingest_latency_ms, upsert_qps, upsert_errors_total), and a tracing span naming convention. i'll paste example queries.
Maya (partnerships): Partner via Partner Bot: "We can provide Grafana snapshots and a CSE to validate dashboards on Wed." :white_check_mark:
Rico (eng): sample prometheus queries: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ingest_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` and `sum(rate(upsert_errors_total[1m])) by (code)` will work. include them in runbook.
Sam (field-eng): runbook checklist draft: 1) enable telemetry env var TELEMETRY=true; 2) configure PROM_PUSHGATEWAY url; 3) run smoke ingest 2k docs; 4) verify p50/p95 ingest latency; 5) validate upsert QPS and error rates.
Nina (pm): marketplace tile copy needs a short line on "Built-in telemetry & marketplace badges" and a compatibility badge list: Snowflake-ready, Databricks-validated, VectorDB-integrations. keep copy <140 chars.
Maya (partnerships): also need legal signoff on the metrics we publish. legal flagged publishing customer error rates verbatim. we should surface ranges not raw counts.
Rico (eng): agreed. we'll publish percentiles and % error rate ranges (e.g., "error rate <0.1% typical"). i'll redact raw PII from logs in the runbook example.
Sam (field-eng): snippet for enabling telemetry: ```bash
export TELEMETRY=1
export PROM_PUSHGATEWAY=https://push.redwood.internal:9091
./connector --config config.yml --telemetry push
```
Maya (partnerships): action items: (1) Sam -> publish runbook + prometheus queries by Tue EOD; (2) Rico -> prepare p50/p95 example CSVs (anonymized) and copy line on error-rate ranges; (3) Nina -> draft marketplace tile copy and 140-char blurb. sync Wed 11:00 PT to review assets.
Partner Bot: Partner reminder: CSE validation Wed 14:00 PT.
Nina (pm): one more: add a small FAQ on "what to do if upsert latency spikes" with steps to reduce ingest concurrency and warm KV cache. i'll draft.
Rico (eng): will add a short ops note: `--concurrency` knob and recommended defaults for demo (4 for small staging, 8 for larger).
Maya (partnerships): perfect. i'll collect brand assets once Nina posts the tile copy. scheduling invite for Wed 11:00 PT. :calendar:
